files.role: Pure upload decisions, unit-tested without Android: where to resume, when to finish, what to do with a finish outcome, bounded resend rounds.

public_objects.name: UploadAction
public_objects.values: SendFrom(afterSeq), Finish, MarkSynced(ackUpTo), RetryLater(reason), NeedsRepair, FailVisible(message)

methods.name: afterBegin
methods.purpose: SendFrom(contiguousSeq) or Finish when contiguousSeq >= localLastSeq.

methods.name: afterFinish
methods.purpose: complete -> MarkSynced(localLastSeq); gaps -> SendFrom(firstGapStart-1) while round < MAX_RESEND_ROUNDS (3); mismatch without gaps or rounds exhausted -> FailVisible; local samples are never acked before MarkSynced.

methods.name: afterError
methods.purpose: Unauthorized -> NeedsRepair; NetworkError/ServerError -> RetryLater; NotFound/Rejected -> FailVisible.

files.role: WorkManager CoroutineWorker (unique work per run id, network-connected constraint, exponential backoff). Executes UploadPlanner decisions against CaptureStore (fetch 1000 per batch, ack + purgeAcked only on MarkSynced) and AtlasClient; updates RunMeta (state, uploadCursor, lastError, needsRepair).

methods.name: doWork
methods.purpose: Run one upload attempt for the run id in input data.

methods.name: enqueueAllPending
methods.purpose: Called at app start and by 'Retry sync'.

files.role: Process-wide singleton (like MobilePlatform) that owns the active run so screen recreation reattaches: start from prepared or free, pause/resume/finish, persists RunMeta on every transition, feeds RunMetricsAccumulator from platform sample flows, offers recover/discard of interrupted captures, enqueues upload at finish. Uses MobilePlatform only; no new GPS/BLE code.

methods.name: startFree
methods.purpose: recorder.start(), RECORDING, ensureForegroundService; returns run id.

methods.name: finish
methods.purpose: Stop, drain, summary via RunMetrics.summarize, PENDING_UPLOAD, enqueue upload.

methods.name: interruptedRuns
methods.purpose: Open captures without a finished RunMeta (offer Recover/Discard).

methods.name: recover
methods.purpose: Reopen as PAUSED with synthetic pause starting at the last sample time.

methods.name: discard
methods.purpose: Explicit user discard: deleteCapture(force = true) and deleteRunMeta.

methods.purpose: Observable state for the Running Screen.
